name: Quote: cat 'file with spaces.txt' (single-quoted path)
notes: cat is a FileVerb (SPEC §6.3) so its positional[0] is a path. The single-quoted Value 'file with spaces.txt' resolves against WorkingDirectory=/work — embedded spaces are preserved through the join. PR 6: cross-platform-safe because the resolver uses bash-style forward-slash path semantics regardless of host OS.
